properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued September 4 at 5:56AM CDT until September 4 at 9:00AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
FFWMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Sheboygan County in east central Wisconsin...

* Until 900 AM CDT.

* At 556 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5 to 1.5 inches in 1
hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sheboygan, Plymouth, Sheboygan Falls, Howards Grove, Oostburg,
Kohler, Elkhart Lake, Waldo, Glenbeulah, Johnsonville, Gibbsville
and Haven.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued September 4 at 6:38AM EDT until September 4 at 8:15AM EDT by NWS Grand Rapids MI
properties.description:
SMWGRR

The National Weather Service in Grand Rapids has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open Waters from St Joseph to Grand Haven MI...

* Until 815 AM EDT.

* At 637 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 12 nm east of Mona Lake Channel to Holland Light to
23 nm west of Saugatuck Pier Heads, moving southeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Saugatuck Pier Heads, South Haven Light, St. Joseph Light, and St.
Joseph.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Menard Creek near Rye affecting Liberty, Hardin and Polk Counties.

For the Menard Creek...including Rye...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Menard Creek near Rye.

* WHEN...Until Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 23.0 feet, Moderate lowland flooding begins as
low-lying areas along the creek are inundated. At 28.0 feet, Major
lowland flooding begins with widespread inundation of the
floodplain in the vicinity of the gage.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 11:15 PM CDT Thursday the stage was 27.8 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 17.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 11:15 PM CDT Thursday was 28.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Saturday morning and continue falling to 11.2 feet Tuesday
evening.
- Flood stage is 20.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.2
feet on 04/21/1979.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
